summary: Software engineer at ExD shipping production demand forecasting (PythinQ: FastAPI, React, LightGBM, PostgreSQL) and multi-agent LLM systems (Omnix: Django, 4 LLM providers).

projects.name: PythinQ
projects.stack: FastAPI, React/TypeScript, Vite, PostgreSQL, LightGBM, Optuna, Docker
bullets: Shipped a 4-grain daily demand-forecasting product on about 5M sales rows so planners upload, train, forecast, and review a calendar-year holdout in one UI.

Routed models by demand shape: Huber LightGBM globally, a quantile specialist for high-variance Material SKUs, and two-stage occurrence/magnitude models for 10,000+ sparse series; Optuna with 7-fold walk-forward on lag, calendar, event, and weather features.
Implemented a Medallion PostgreSQL store, viewer/analyst/admin RBAC, and a Postgres-backed async worker so ingest, training, and multi-day forecasts keep running after the HTTP request returns.

Added predecessor SKU maps that blend history into new packs without merging identities. CI (pytest, Ruff, basedpyright) catches missing weather/events, split-mode errors, and train/serve schema drift before deployment.

projects.name: Omnix AI
projects.stack: Django, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI
bullets: Implemented one LLM routing layer across 4 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI) with primary/fallback pairs and retries, so rate limits or provider outages fail over without aborting the panel.
Rebuilt panel creation and debate launch as guided wizards, enforcing Super Expert + 3 to 9 expert rosters and a model assignment for every adviser before a debate can launch.
Moved debate start/continue, persona generation, and library batch work onto an async worker with per-user job locks so multi-minute runs survive HTTP timeouts.

Built a multi-tenant eCommerce platform with Next.js and PostgreSQL (isolated storefronts/admin on shared infrastructure, plus single-tenant mode) and a pluggable upload layer (local filesystem and MinIO).
Set up GitHub Actions to build, test, and deploy to the dev environment on every push, with manual promotion to staging/main.

Built and deployed a full-stack app (React, Node.js, MongoDB Atlas) with Docker and GitHub Actions to Docker Hub and Render; converted Django advertisement-marketplace pages to a Django + React (Vite) hybrid.
Tracked performance and reliability with Loki, Prometheus and Grafana.
Built a DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm) detection system using DeepD2V embeddings on 200k domain records, reaching 0.94 holdout accuracy and outperforming n-gram and reputation baselines.

projects.name: Rice Quality Check (FYP)
bullets: Built an AI system in a 3-member team to classify 8 Pakistani rice varieties and detect adulteration, reaching 92% average accuracy across 6 fine-tuned models on 10,000+ grain images.
